reviewer: Pickle: official-source review of the Korea Consumer Agency comparison report 2023-20 on LED desk stands (12 products), the attached result table PDF, and the three Coupang listings checked live on 2026-11-19
method: Reviewed the draft against the Korea Consumer Agency report page (consumer.go.kr, published 2023-11-28) and its attached comparison table PDF downloaded on 2026-11-19. Every figure in the article was taken from those two files: the 12-product purchase price and rated wattage table, the maximum illuminance values (1,007/1,099/1,221/1,334/1,337/1,432/1,510/1,514/1,667/1,782/1,802/2,053 lx), the 40 cm and 9-point uniformity measurement, the 30 cm ring distance, the KS C 7656 and KS A 3011 range of 600-1,500 lx and the six products inside it, the two products rated excellent on uniformity (Reto, Bandi) and two rated ordinary (No Brand, Prism), the ten products rated excellent on flicker with Nexover and Reto ordinary, the three excellent on colour rendering (Duplex, Britz, Philips), the 2,000-hour lumen maintenance criterion of 90 percent with 95-117 percent results, the 42-82 lm/W efficacy spread and 1.9x ratio, the 1,400-2,400 won annual electricity range at 3 hours a day and 160 won per kWh, the EMC failures at Duplex DP-031LS and Samjung SL-2300 with the vendors 2023-11-23 and 2023-11-24 improvement replies, and the marking failures at Bandi T500 and Britz BE-LED50 with the 2023-11-09 and 2023-11-07 replies. Annual cost figures were recalculated by hand from rated wattage (13.7 W gives 15 kWh and 2,400 won; 8.1 W gives 8.87 kWh and 1,419 won) and match the agency range. Coupang was checked in the signed-in browser on 2026-11-19: Reto LLS-01 at 33,910 won with 4,063 reviews and 4.5 rating, Philips 9290032130 at 52,320 won after a 9 percent wow coupon from 57,500 won with 440 reviews, and Bandi T500 stand type at 48,000 won plus 3,000 won shipping with 2 reviews. All three listing URLs were opened through the AFFSDP deep links to confirm they land on the intended model, not a redirect. The article states where the marketplace listing differs from the tested item (Bandi shipping cost, Philips flicker note on some modes, Reto flicker rating). No AI wording, no tilde ranges, no diagnosis or treatment wording; category home because the site taxonomy has no lighting entry and other appliance guides sit there. The affiliate box sits only at the bottom after the FAQ, with no top or inline box, per the 2026-11-17 approval-first layout.
